title: The Princess Diaries
author: Meg Cabot
summary: Mia Thermopolis, a clumsy New York teenager, learns from her father that he is the prince of Genovia. She must keep it secret while coping with school, crushes and a strict grandmother.
readIf: you want a light, funny teen diary with a lot of awkward charm.
skipIf: you want a serious story or have outgrown teenage voice narrators.
